note: How maastokartta.json is drawn at each print scale. px_mm is the paper size of one style pixel (line widths, icons, spacing); zoom_offset is added to the scale's style zoom; text_scale and halo_scale multiply text sizes and halo widths on top of px_mm. overrides are per-layer style overrides: visibility, minzoom, maxzoom, filter (ANDed with the layer's own), paint, layout, line-width-scale and line-width-add (px, applied after scale). "note" and "notes" fields are explanations only.

notes.px_mm: contour/road weights match the MML raster 1:25 000
notes.zoom_offset: style zoom >= 13 everywhere in Finland (contours, symbols)
notes.text_scale: names the size of the raster's (F5)

korkeus_apuviiva.note: 2.5 m dashed contours fully drawn, as on the raster (the style fades them below zoom 13.5), as long dashes with short gaps (1.6 mm / 0.4 mm, like the reference print map) at their ~0.11 mm width here

mml-vedenpinta.note: lake surface heights, shown on the raster

mml-symboli.note: fell-vegetation ticks (symbol class 32715) left out: the heath and open-land colours already show this

road-case-surface.note: road edges 0.1 mm, like the reference print map: the casing is 2 x 0.121 mm wider than the fill here, so it shrinks by 2 x 0.021 mm, i.e. -2 * (0.121 - 0.100) / 0.115 px (same for all road casings)

notes.px_mm: thin, light lines like the 1:50 000 reference (F2)
notes.zoom_offset: the 1:25 000 style zoom, i.e. the same detail drawn finer
notes.text_scale: small names as on the reference, readable at px_mm 0.07 (F5)

korkeus_viiva.note: 5 m contours, 20 m index contours (korkeusarvo divisible by 20000) thicker: the reference's interval

mml-vedenpinta.note: lake surface heights, as on the reference

nimisto-maasto-vedet.note: only names meant for 1:50 000 maps: MML tags each place name with the smallest map scale it belongs on (mittakaavarelevanssi); names tagged 25 000 are 1:25 000 detail, and untagged (0) entries are service points (churches, museums, malls), not map names. National parks and municipalities have their own layers and keep their names.

nimisto-maasto-vedet-mat-prio.note: only names meant for 1:50 000 maps (see nimisto-maasto-vedet)

nimisto.note: only names meant for 1:50 000 maps (see nimisto-maasto-vedet)

mml-symboli.note: fell-vegetation ticks (symbol class 32715) left out: the heath and open-land colours already show this

mml-polku.note: lines are finer at 1:50 000 (px_mm), so the thin linework people navigate by (trails, fences, borders) gets wider again
